comments.author: mrkgnao
comments.why: Shows Musk's early speaking style compared to now.
comments.text: He's definitely matured a ton as a speaker. I mean, he isn't smooooth now, but there are far fewer pauses, to the point where it's just another striking feature about him instead of making his words hard to follow. Also, the kid being held aloft at 34:20 was a very cute touch. [VIDEO]
